name: Query Clinical Prostate Cancer Guidelines via ChromaDB
description: Performs semantic search against clinical prostate cancer guidelines (EAU & ESMO) in ChromaDB to retrieve formal clinical evidence, recommendations, and diagnostic thresholds.

query.description: Specific clinical or urological search query (e.g. 'PIRADS 3 and PSA density biopsy threshold', 'prior confirmed prostate cancer repeat biopsy indication').

n_results.description: Number of relevant text chunks to retrieve.
